outcomes.name: The pilot has validated that the impact of the change has been identified and understood
The pilot has validated that impacts have been assessed, validated and prioritised
The pilot has validated that change impacts are actively managed through plans, governance and support

actions.action: S Review and refine: recognise that the change is likely to affect people, processes, services, roles and ways of working.
M Continue discussions from the pilot with leaders and stakeholders regarding who or what may be affected by the change.
M Confirm high-level business areas, services, teams and stakeholder groups likely to experience change impacts.
M Confirm stakeholder perceptions of where change may affect their roles, activities or responsibilities.
M Confirm potential areas of disruption, opportunity or uncertainty associated with the change.
S Review and refine: gain agreement that change impact assessment activities will be required.
M Review and refine: begin raising awareness that different stakeholder groups may be affected in different ways.
S Review pilot learnings on previous change initiatives to identify common impact themes, challenges and lessons learned.
M Confirm and document the areas, services, teams, roles, processes and stakeholder groups affected by the change (Stakeholder Analysis)
M Review and refine: undertake a draft structured Change Impact Assessment covering people, process, technology, information, governance and ways of working.
S Re-assess risks arising from identified change impacts (RAID log).
M Review and refine: engage affected stakeholder groups to understand current ways of working and expected impacts.
M Re-assess stakeholder concerns, support requirements, perceived disruption and areas of uncertainty (Change Impact Assessment).
M Re-assess existing pain points, bottlenecks, duplication, workarounds and service pressures that may influence the scale of impact (Current State Process Mapping/Heat Map/Change Impact Assessment)
S Confirm the pilot-tested and establish baseline measures that will enable comparison between current and future states.
M Review and refine: complete a detailed change impact assessment across affected business areas, services, teams and roles.
M Re-assess the scale of impact using agreed criteria such as complexity, frequency, number of people affected and degree of difference from current ways of working.
M Review and refine: translate significant change impacts into change risks, issues or mitigations where appropriate (RAID log).
M Review pilot learnings on assessed impacts and associated risks, through appropriate governance routes so that decisions are informed by change impact evidence (RAID log).
S Confirm dependencies that could affect impact management, including process, workforce, system, policy, operational or external dependencies (RAID log).
M Re-validate identified impacts with affected stakeholders and subject matter experts (Change Impact Assessment/Change Agent).
M Re-measure the effectiveness of change impact management activities across impacted stakeholder groups, services and business areas
S Review pilot learnings on impact assessment findings to identify remaining high-impact areas requiring support or intervention.
S Consolidate stakeholder feedback regarding actual impacts experienced during implementation.
M Re-validate that identified impacts, mitigations and support activities remain relevant and effective
S Review and refine: adjust impact management interventions using implementation experience, stakeholder feedback and operational insight.
S Re-assess whether anticipated impacts have occurred and whether mitigation activities achieved the desired outcome.
M Review and refine: continuously review future impact-related risks, dependencies and emerging organisational pressures
S Continue monitoring long-term impact trends, outcomes and organisational consequences of change initiatives
M Promote at scale a culture where change impacts are proactively assessed, managed and used to inform organisational improvement
S Sustain organisation-wide insight mechanisms to identify emerging or cumulative impacts from ongoing change activity
S Review and refine: benchmark change impact management performance and maturity across programmes and change initiatives.
S Review and refine: capture and apply organisational learning from change impact successes, challenges and implementation experience
S Review and refine: recognise and reinforce good practice in identifying, managing and mitigating change impacts
